newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks close mixed on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks close mixed on profit-taking.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index shed points to end weaker for third day in a row, but broader market mixed as advancers edge out decliners. * 84 million shares traded worth C$1.3 billion.
Toronto stocks ended mixed in moderate trading on Thursday as investors again decided to take profits following earlier record-setting days.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index lost 18.70 points to reach 6370.33, finishing lower for the third day in a row.
However advancing issues inched past decliners 474 to 471 in lackluster dealings while another 310 traded flat.
"It's more profit-taking than anything else," said Investment Advisor Ira Katzin at RBC Dominion Securities.
